# Auras reference

The component that emits an aura and the asset that defines who it reaches, how far and how often. For how to use it, see [Auras](../modules/auras.md).

## VtAuraEmitter

Component. Add it with **Add Component → Vantage → Auras → VtAuraEmitter**.

Per-unit aura emitter — runtime driver for a `VtAuraDefinition`. Every `VtAuraDefinition.refreshIntervalSeconds` seconds (and only on the authoritative side), it sweeps an OverlapSphere around the caster, filters candidates by faction + optional unit tags, and re-applies the aura's buff to each match. Units in range stay refreshed; units leaving stop being refreshed and the buff lapses naturally on its own duration.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Definition (`definition`) | [VtAuraDefinition](#vtauradefinition) | None |  | The aura this emitter drives. Assigned at edit time on prefabs / via code at runtime. Changing the assignment after Awake is supported — the next tick uses the new definition. |
| Overlap Buffer Size (`overlapBufferSize`) | `int` | 32 | ≥ 4 | Pre-allocated buffer size for OverlapSphereNonAlloc. Increase if your scenes have crowded radii (e.g. boss arenas with 50+ units in a 30m aura). Allocations only happen at startup; ticks are GC-free. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `VtAuraDefinition Definition { get; set; }` | The aura definition this emitter drives. Setting at runtime re-applies the mutual-exclusion check against siblings. |
| `void Tick(float deltaTime)` | Advance the emit cadence by `deltaTime` seconds and run an emit pass once `VtAuraDefinition.refreshIntervalSeconds` has accumulated. The only time input this component consumes; `Update` forwards `Time.deltaTime`. |
| `void Refresh()` | Force an immediate emit pass (bypasses cadence). Useful after teleport / respawn / when the consumer wants the aura to take effect instantly instead of waiting for the next interval. |

## VtAuraDefinition

Asset. Create it with **Create → Vantage → Auras → Aura Definition**.

Designer-authored aura — a persistent emanating effect that re-applies a `VtBuffDefinition` to every eligible unit in radius on each emitter tick. An armor aura for nearby allies, a self-only damage reduction and a hex that slows and damages nearby enemies are all auras.

### Inspector fields

#### Identity

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Id (`id`) | `string` | Empty |  | Stable string identifier for DB / network payloads. Convention: lowercase dotted, e.g. 'aura.armor', 'aura.frost_hex'. |
| Display Name (`displayName`) | `string` | Empty |  | UI display name. E.g. 'Armor Aura', 'Frost Hex'. |
| Description (`description`) | `string` | Empty |  | Tooltip / lore description. |
| Icon (`icon`) | `Sprite` | None |  | Optional inventory / aura-bar icon. |

#### Effect

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Buff To Apply (`buffToApply`) | [VtBuffDefinition](units.md#vtbuffdefinition) | None |  | VtBuffDefinition this aura applies. RECOMMENDED: author the buff with stackingPolicy = Refresh so multiple casters of the same aura don't double-stack on a target — they refresh a single instance, sharing one modifier source row. Different auras (different VtBuffDefinition refs) stack naturally as separate buff instances. |

#### Geometry

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Radius (`radius`) | `float` | 8 | ≥ 0 | Effect radius in world units. Anything outside this sphere doesn't get the buff. Typical melee aura 8–12; party aura 30+; touch aura 1.5. |
| Target Mask (`targetMask`) | `LayerMask` | Everything |  | Layers considered by the OverlapSphere. Set to your unit-collider layers for performance — Everything works for prototyping but wastes work on scenery. |

#### Filters

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Target Filter (`targetFilter`) | [VtAuraTargetFilter](#vtauratargetfilter) | `Allies` |  | Which units the aura considers eligible — by faction. |
| Required Tags (`requiredTags`) | [VtUnitTagDefinition](units.md#vtunittagdefinition)[] | Empty |  | Required unit tags — candidate must have ALL of these to be affected. Empty = no requirement. Use case: a mana aura restricted to tag.caster (mages / priests). |
| Excluded Tags (`excludedTags`) | [VtUnitTagDefinition](units.md#vtunittagdefinition)[] | Empty |  | Excluded unit tags — candidate is skipped if it has ANY of these. Empty = no exclusion. Use case: a plague aura damages every living enemy but ignores tag.construct. |

#### Cadence

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Refresh Interval Seconds (`refreshIntervalSeconds`) | `float` | 0.25 | ≥ 0.05 | Seconds between emitter ticks. Each tick re-applies the buff to every eligible unit in radius — units in range stay refreshed, units leaving stop being refreshed and the buff fades naturally on its own duration. 0.25s suits most games; smaller = more responsive but more CPU. |
| Buffer Multiplier (`bufferMultiplier`) | `float` | 2.5 | ≥ 1.1 | Multiplier on refreshIntervalSeconds used as the buff's applied duration. Should be > 1 so a unit that barely missed a tick still has the buff active until the next tick refreshes it. Default 2.5 means: tick=0.25s, duration=0.625s — buffs lapse cleanly within ~0.6s of leaving range. |

#### Caster-side exclusion

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Mutually Exclusive With (`mutuallyExclusiveWith`) | [VtAuraDefinition](#vtauradefinition)[] | Empty |  | Other auras that cannot be active simultaneously on the same caster. Enabling this aura disables any listed aura currently emitting on the caster, so a class can have several auras but only one active at a time. Symmetric — listing the relationship in either direction is enough. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `float AppliedBuffDuration { get; }` | Convenience: `refreshIntervalSeconds * bufferMultiplier`. The duration the emitter applies the buff with on each tick. |

## Enums

### VtAuraTargetFilter

Faction-based eligibility filter for `VtAuraEmitter`'s per-tick target sweep. Combined with optional unit-tag filtering on `VtAuraDefinition.requiredTags` / `excludedTags` for finer granularity (e.g. "buff allied beasts only").

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `SelfOnly` | Buff applies only to the caster itself. Use case: defensive passives such as a bone shield or iron skin. |
| `Allies` | Same VtFaction as the caster, including the caster. Use case: party-wide regen aura. |
| `AlliesExceptSelf` | Same VtFaction as the caster, excluding the caster. Use case: leadership aura that buffs everyone but the leader. |
| `Enemies` | Different VtFaction from the caster, ignoring Neutral. Use case: hex aura that slows nearby enemies. |
| `AllUnits` | Every unit in radius regardless of faction (still excludes Neutral from being treated as either ally or enemy — they're skipped). Use case: area-of-effect ground hazard, weather effect, plague aura. |
| `PartyMembers` | The emitter's unit and every member of its party. A solo emitter affects only itself. Use case: a paladin aura that should not help strangers who merely share the faction. |
